title: Mirabel and the Safehouse
author: O. M. Nystrom
blurb: Paloma Joubert, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
